svg.title: Figure 6-1 · Capability profile (WP-M-13)
svg.desc: Capability profile of the WP-M-13 self-assessment: PA 1.1 per process SYS.1 N; SYS.2 N; SYS.3 P; SYS.4 P; SYS.5 P; SWE.1 N; SWE.2 N; SWE.3 L safety code / P rest; SWE.4 L safety code / P rest; SWE.5 L; SWE.6 P; MLE.1 N; MLE.2 N; MLE.3 N; MLE.4 P; HWE.1 N; HWE.2 N; HWE.3 N; HWE.4 P; SUP.1 N; SUP.8 L; SUP.9 N; SUP.10 P; MAN.3 N; MAN.5 N; SEC.1 N; SEC.2 P; SEC.3 N; SEC.4 N; SUP.11 N; VAL.1 P; ACQ.4 P; MAN.7 P. PA 2.1 and PA 2.2 N for all. Target CL2 for group A, CL1 for group B, none for group C.
svg.text: PA 1.1 rating per process as its ISO/IEC 33020 achievement band, PA 2.1 / PA 2.2, current CL, and the PA 1.1 level the target CL needs (self-assessment, not a formal assessment)
PA 1.1 process performance (achievement band, §2 rating scale)
Software detailed design and unit construction
§4.6 Cybersecurity, ML data, validation, supplier monitoring

CL1 reached: SWE.3 (safety code), SWE.4 (safety code), SWE.5, SUP.8. CL2 reached: none. At target: 0 of 25 processes with a target (17 group A, 8 group B). PA 2.1 and PA 2.2 are N for every process (§5).

Bars show the band the rating stands for, not a measured percentage. Split ratings: upper bar = safety code (opendbc safety + panda firmware where stated), lower bar = rest. Ratings are indicative (self-assessment at 8b8c6ae).
PA 1.1 level the target needs (CL1: L, CL2: F; §2 rule)
